column1: # Each lane's slot for its Playwright runs (T2, 10 November 2026: two lanes' runs met on vite's 5184/5185).
# Every Playwright config but live/ and deck-capture/ serves on its own port plus 100 x $OSPREY_PORTS_SLOT
# (OspreyFlow_Core/apps/lanePorts.ts, which knows no lane and no table). The slot is set from this table by
# scripts/stack_lease.sh for every run on the test server (offline too) and by scripts/lanes_launch.sh for a lane's
# session; by the lane's exact name only, so a sub-lane or a sister lane (admin-ddl, admin-b) never takes its
# parent's: it is "unlisted-<lane>", refused in words by a Playwright run until it has a row here. With no slot a
# main checkout keeps today's ports (slot 0) and a linked worktree is refused. The blocks stay clear of each other,
# of the stacks' ports (lane_stacks.tsv) and of the owner's deployment's (2480, 5432, 80, 8000, 8080, 8081):
# tests/test_lane_ports.py checks it, and that every lane folder under process/lanes/ has its row.
